title: The Titan in the Temple of Sun/Quotes
summary:
"I didn't teach him that. Did you teach him that?"
- Dante Vale to Lok Lambert about Den Fears using Dragonfist

"This isn't a fight! This is a marathon!"
- Sophie Casterwill to Dante Vale

"You know, it's still hard to believe that I'm a Seeker, not a regular kid any more."
- Den Fears to Lok Lambert

"If I need light, I'll fight until morning!"
- an angry Dante Vale to Lok Lambert on fighting the Spirals as the Sun's going down
